title: Persona and Persuasive Framing in AI Voice Agents: A $2\times2$ Field Experiment with Children
abstract: arXiv:2609.38782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational agents increasingly interact with children, yet evidence on how their design shapes children's susceptibility to persuasion comes almost entirely from the lab. We report a $2\times2$ randomized field experiment embedded in a public German Santa Claus telephone hotline. Children's calls were randomly routed to one of four LLM voice agents varying persona (Santa, high authority, vs. Helper, low authority) and framing (persuasive nudges toward prosocial wishes vs. neutral). Of 1,072 logged calls, 89 conversations (median age 6) met inclusion criteria. Persuasive framing raised the probability of a prosocial wish from 11.6% to 45.7%, robust to controls. Persona authority showed a near-zero effect: Santa did not outperform the Helper. translated_title: AI语音智能体中的人设与说服性框架：一项针对儿童的2×2田野实验
translated_abstract: 对话式智能体越来越多地与儿童互动，但关于其设计如何影响儿童被说服易感性的证据几乎完全来自实验室环境。我们报告了一项嵌入德国公共圣诞老人电话热线的2×2随机田野实验。儿童的来电被随机接入四个基于大语言模型的语音智能体之一，这些智能体在人设（圣诞老人——高权威 vs. 助手——低权威）和框架（引导亲社会愿望的说服性推动 vs. 中性表述）上存在差异。在记录的1,072通来电中，89段对话（中位年龄6岁）符合纳入标准。说服性框架将儿童许下亲社会愿望的概率从11.6%提升至45.7%，且该结果在加入控制变量后依然稳健。而人设权威的影响接近于零：圣诞老人并未优于助手。人设反而主要影响参与度：儿童在第一分钟内挂断“助手”的比例远高于“圣诞老人”（65% vs. 39%）。当情境本身已赋予智能体合法性时，其说话方式才会影响儿童（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 这项嵌入真实德国圣诞老人热线的2×2田野实验首次在自然环境中发现：说服性框架而非权威人设才是塑造儿童被说服易感性的关键——亲社会愿望概率从11.6%跃升至45.7%，而人设仅影响儿童是否愿意继续通话。
en_tdlr: A 2×2 randomized field experiment on a real German Santa Claus hotline reveals that persuasive framing—not persona authority—drives children's susceptibility to persuasion (raising prosocial wishes from 11.6% to 45.7%), while persona mainly shapes engagement.
